implementation: Added `--local` for a selected `model probe` path/call. It captures actual call arguments transiently, clones the selected module and input tensors, replays the chosen invocation, and returns invocation-scoped input/output metadata. At most 8 calls are replayed; global side effects from arbitrary user code remain outside the copy boundary.

Added optional `--batch-fingerprint` for deterministic Dataset factories whose dataset implements stable `sample_id(index)`. Evidence identity covers project Python/TOML/small YAML sources, external Python source for custom module classes, installed dependency versions, model state, model/batch params, injection metadata, variant, contract, worker protocol, sample/split identity and probe selection.

Only eval-mode probes with stable sample IDs and successful FX/Meta static coverage are cached. Training, dynamic/unsupported graphs, missing identities, incomplete source inventory, oversized weights and partial contracts fail closed. Budget/timeout values are excluded from the key.

Cache files contain only structural tensor metadata, contract and call identity; user Tensor values, batch params, sample IDs and credentials are not stored. Cache files are atomically replaced with mode 0600 in a mode 0700 directory, retain at most 64 records, and report source/batch/weights/dependency/variant invalidation reasons.

Added bounded per-invocation structural evidence reconciliation for source-only edits. It reuses unaffected call metadata only when static FX/Meta coverage, complete trace, stable input-content signatures, unique call identity, complete source inventory and isolated implementation-file attribution all hold. The current root forward always executes; cached Tensor values are never reused.

limitations: The declared dataset fingerprint is the data provider/user revision boundary. When external sample contents change, callers must change this fingerprint; raw tensors are deliberately not hashed or persisted.
Source/dependency and weight fingerprinting is bounded. Unknown or oversized inputs disable cache reuse and report a reason.
FX/Meta unsupported dynamic paths are always reprobed. Local replay copies module state and tensor arguments but cannot isolate arbitrary external side effects.

Partial reuse is limited to structural metadata. Every invocation still performs a real root forward; dynamic paths, shared/repeated calls, incomplete input fingerprints, un-attributable helper/root sources and any non-source identity change expand to a full probe. It does not reduce forward compute or prove unexecuted branches.
